declarations.description:
Shows a person or entity as an image, initials or any slotted content, with an optional status dot or badge.

Resolution order: the `src` image (falling back to initials if it fails to load), then slotted content, then the
initials computed from `name`. Set `auto-color` to derive a stable background hue from the name.
declarations.name: Avatar

cssProperties.description: e.g. `0 0 0 2px #fff` for a ring in stacked groups.
cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar--box-shadow

cssProperties.description: Saturation of the hue derived from the name.
cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar__auto-color--saturation

cssProperties.description: Lightness of the hue derived from the name.
cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar__auto-color--lightness

cssProperties.description: Diameter of the status dot; slotted badges size themselves.
cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar__badge--size

cssProperties.description: Ring separating the badge from the avatar.
cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar__badge--border

cssProperties.description: Positive values push the badge outwards.
cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar__badge--offset

slots.description: Custom content shown instead of the initials (an icon, an emoji, an ``).
Small element pinned to the bottom-right corner (a count, an icon). Replaces the `status` dot.
slots.name: badge

slots.description: Icon shown over an editable avatar. Defaults to a camera.
slots.name: edit-icon

slots.description: Icon shown in the remove action. Defaults to a close mark.
slots.name: remove-icon

members.name: status
members.description: Presence dot in the bottom-right corner.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables editable avatar actions.

members.name: hue

members.name: file
members.description: Locally selected image file, if the avatar was changed through its picker.

declarations.description:
Responsive stack of `c2-avatar` elements. It observes its rendered width and each avatar's actual size, then hides
the avatars that no longer fit and replaces them with a count. The host fills the available inline space up to
`--c2-avatar-group--max-width`, so it also reacts when its parent becomes narrower.
declarations.name: AvatarGroup

cssProperties.description: Maximum responsive width of the group.
cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar-group--max-width

cssProperties.description: Ring applied to slotted avatars so overlaps stay distinct.
cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar-group__avatar--box-shadow

cssProperties.description: Width and height of the overflow count.
cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar-group__overflow--size

cssParts.description: Count shown after the visible avatars.
cssParts.name: overflow

members.name: maxVisible
members.description: Optional hard cap in addition to the automatically calculated responsive limit. Zero means no hard cap.

members.name: countMode
members.description: Whether the overflow indicator shows `+hidden` or the total number of avatars.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name for the group.

members.name: total
members.description: Current number of slotted avatars.

members.name: visible
members.description: Current number of visible avatars.

members.name: hiddenCount
members.description: Current number of avatars represented by the overflow count.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Recalculates the responsive limit after application code changes a slotted avatar's dimensions.

events.name: overflow-change
events.description: Fired when resizing changes the visible or hidden counts.

attributes.name: max-visible
attributes.description: Optional hard cap in addition to the automatically calculated responsive limit. Zero means no hard cap.

attributes.name: count-mode
attributes.description: Whether the overflow indicator shows `+hidden` or the total number of avatars.
